answer: Admission auction stops fake identities. Each epoch opens 200 seats: applicants file sealed bids signed with a quill and pay the clearing price. Winners step onto the terrace, seats locked 20 epochs and non-transferable, so a bought seat cannot be resold. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 coins, while one honest agent pays 50 and earns undiluted rewards. A zephyr of cheap copies cannot pass a gate charging every copy full price.
